FAQ

Common questions

Short answers. Ask us if yours is not here.

What is Facet?

Facet is a modular core that clicks into three interchangeable shells: jewelry, analog watch, and athletic band.

How do I switch shells?

Click the core out of one shell and into another. The same core works in every shell, so switching takes seconds.

Does the core keep my tracking when I switch?

Yes. Your weekly picture stays with the core, so the look changes and the tracking stays.

Which shells are available?

Three: the jewelry, the analog watch, and the athletic band. You can see each one on the Shells tab.

How much does it cost?

Pricing appears on each order page. If you want a price before you buy, send an inquiry from the Inquiries tab.

Are the reviews real?

The reviews on this site are samples for now, so the layout is visible. We will replace them with reviews from real customers before we publish.

How do I contact you?

Use the Inquiries tab. We read every message and reply by email.
